source_text:
18.12 Καὶ γὰρ ὁ δοῦλός σου φυλάσσει αὐτὰ, ἐν
τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτὰ ἀνταπόδοσις πολλή. Σαφῶς ἡμῖν καὶ τοῦτο δεδήλωται ἐν τῷ
προλαβόντι ψαλμῷ, ἀληθινὰ καὶ δίκαια παρὰ τοῦ ἀληθοῦς Θεοῦ καὶ δικαιοκρίτου
δεδι καιωμένα λέγεται· ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ δέ ἐστιν κατὰ τὸν αὐτὸν λόγον· ῳ γὰρ λόγῳ
ἐστιν ἀληθῆ, τούτῳ τυγχάνει καὶ δίκαια. –Εἰ ὁ δοῦλός σου φυλάσσει αὐτὰ, ὁ μὴ
φυλάσσων, οὐ δοῦ λός σου. Φυλάσσει δὲ τὰ ἐπιθυμητὰ τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὁ ἐπιθυμῶν οὐκ
α λλο τι η αὐτά· διὸ ε χει ἀνταπόδοσιν τῶν ἐπὶ Θεοῦ μελλομένων πολλήν.
pass_a_gloss: And for the servant of-you keeps them, in the to-keep them recompense much. Clearly to-us also this has-been-shown in the preceding psalm, true and just from the true God and just-judge having-been-justified they-are-said; upon the same and it-is according-to the same reason; to-which for reason they-are true, to-this they-happen also just. If the servant of-you keeps them, the not keeping, not servant of-you. He-keeps and the desirable-things of-the God, the desiring not other something than them; wherefore he-has recompense of-the upon God going-to-be much.
pass_b_english: “For indeed your servant keeps them; in the keeping of them there is much recompense” (Psalm 18:12).

This also has been clearly shown to us in the preceding psalm: they are said to be true and just, justified by the true God and just judge; and “together” is according to the same reason; for by the reason they are true, by this they also happen to be just. If your servant keeps them, the one who does not keep them is not your servant. And the one who keeps the desirable things of God is the one who desires nothing other than them; therefore he has a great recompense of the things that are to come from God.

choices.term: ἐν τῷ φυλάσσειν αὐτὰ ἀνταπόδοσις πολλή
choices.english: in the keeping of them there is much recompense
choices.why: Recompense is in the keeping, not a second law. OCR ἀνταπόδοσις kept.
rejected: there is much repayment after death only
keeping them is itself the law

choices.term: ᾧ γὰρ λόγῳ ἐστιν ἀληθῆ, τούτῳ τυγχάνει καὶ δίκαια
choices.english: by the reason they are true, by this they also happen to be just
choices.why: OCR ῳ is ᾧ. Same λόγος makes them both true and just. Not ‘true instead of just’.
rejected: they are true instead of just

choices.term: ὁ μὴ φυλάσσων, οὐ δοῦλός σου
choices.english: the one who does not keep them is not your servant
choices.why: Negation on the keeper, not on God. OCR δοῦ λός.
rejected: the one who keeps them is not your servant
God does not keep the servant

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
